name: 1 · dashboard panels

name: seed-862 · workload-01
story: Workload set Random mixed · seed-862, workload-01: nine repeating PromQL queries planned with the default search, as the MVP deployment (raw data not retained, AWS Fargate prices, accuracy guarantees enforced).
